test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held On: 28 June, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Select the option that is NOT true, according to the passage.

options.text: One should take out time to look deep into oneself.
Life has so much to offer.
Human beings are in control of their mind.
Money gives freedom to do whatever we want to do.

solution:
The correct answer is:** 'Human beings are in control of their mind'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• According to the passage, the option that is not true is:** 'Human beings are in control of their mind'.**
 
• The option contradicts to the tone of the passage and depicts different attitudes of human beings.
 
• The passage depicts the various positive aspects of life to make life prosperous.

​Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options are mentioned in the passage. Therefore, the options are correct according to the passage.
